description:
Omniscient is an organic growth agency that builds revenue-focused organic growth systems for B2B software companies — optimized for both search engines and generative AI.

We pride ourselves on being lean, agile, and experimental. Our team thrives on R&D and innovation, always exploring the smartest ways to deliver exceptional results. We believe in a culture of building and shipping — whether it’s client deliverables, new services, or internal tools that keep us ahead of the game.

If you’re looking for a role where you’ll tackle challenging problems, work with ambitious brands, and help shape the future of organic growth, let’s talk.

Learn about the principles that drive how we work and build a company.

As a Senior AEO & SEO Strategist, you own the AEO and SEO channel across a book of 5-6 B2B accounts: the channel plan, the execution, and the results that get our clients discovered, recommended, and cited in Google and AI answers. You’re accountable for visibility, pipeline, and revenue from owned surfaces.

You partner with each account’s Account Manager, who owns the overall strategy and client relationship. The AM sets the account’s priorities. You turn them into a channel plan that works, pressure-test their calls with evidence, and deliver. When the room needs deep AEO and SEO expertise, or the AM is out, you step in and lead.

You’ll also help shape how Omniscient does AEO and SEO: measurement standards, playbooks, and experiments the whole team adopts. You report to the Team Lead, AEO & SEO.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the channel plan: Translate account objectives set with the AM into a prioritized AEO and SEO roadmap, covering topical authority and voice-of-customer mapped to the prompt set, technical retrieval health, and consistency with off-site surfaces, in partnership with Digital PR. We expect you to build experimentation into it

  • Execute and direct execution: Direct the craft teams that your channel leans on (Editorial & Creative, Analytics, and Technical & Dev), plus AI agents for research and reporting. Review everything for channel fit before it reaches the client. Your name is on it

  • Bring a POV to your AM: Recommend strategic pillars and channel priorities, flag risks early, and push back when the data says we need to move in another direction. You give the AM depth; they give the account direction

  • Measure and translate: Own AEO and SEO reporting for your accounts. Treat visibility as the leading indicator and pipeline as the goal. Give the AM the evidence and narrative they need for QBRs and renewals

  • Client communication and education: Lead channel working sessions with client practitioners, cover for the AM when needed, and present channel results to client leadership

  • Raise the bar: Spend about 20% of your time on experimentation, methodology, and playbooks. Mentor analysts and junior strategists

  • Support sales: Act as the channel expert on proposals and sales calls

Who you are

  • You have 4–6+ years in SEO, organic growth, or content strategy, including complex or enterprise B2B accounts

  • You’ve been hands-on in AI search and AEO, and can help set the standard for how a team measures and executes on AI visibility and citation data

  • You ship, not just recommend. You’ve owned execution and can point to work you delivered that moved a client metric

  • You make channel calls with conviction on imperfect data, and you can explain what would change your mind

  • You partner well with an account lead. You disagree openly with evidence, then commit and deliver

  • You’ve built AI workflows or agents for SEO work, and you know where human review still matters

  • You communicate clearly enough to present channel results to a VP, and you’re meticulous in your work (the passcode is aeoseo2027)

  • You are not an asshole. We spend a lot of our days engaging with team members and clients. There is no room for assholes. You are friendly, eager to jump in and take ownership, and love to work as a team to be successful

Why you should work with us

  • Remote flexibility: We are a 100% remote company so that you can work from anywhere

  • Real impact: You will have a massive impact on a growing company rather than being another cog in a machine

  • Opportunity for responsibility: We offer ample opportunities to take on more responsibility and shape how the function works

  • Coaching: We will coach you up toward becoming world-class at your function

Benefits

We are fortunate to offer competitive salaries and benefits, and we strive to create an environment that allows you to do your best work, develop your skills, and grow your career.

  • Health insurance: 90% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums paid for employees in the US

  • 401k with employer match: We match 100% of your contributions up to the first 3% of pay, then 50% of your contributions on the next 2% of pay

  • Profit share: Opportunity to participate in our quarterly profit share program after 1 year of employment

  • Unlimited vacation: We trust you to take care of your work and communicate when you need time off. We recommend a minimum of 14 days a year

  • Learning and development stipend: $2,000 to spend on professional development after 1 year of employment

  • Free books program: We cover the cost of a Kindle and 1 Kindle book a month

  • Networking stipend: $50 per month to spend on coffee or lunch for professional networking.

  • 100% remote flexibility: Work from wherever you want

  • Annual team offsites: We organize an annual team trip. Cities and countries we’ve been to include Boston, Austin, Chicago, San Diego, Costa Rica, and Belgrade, Serbia

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there’s no such thing as a "perfect" candidate. Omniscient Digital is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify and whatever background you bring, please apply if the idea of this role excites you.

Omniscient Digital is an equal opportunity employer. We ensure equal opportunity, and all candidates are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

___

By submitting your application, you agree that Omniscient Digital may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Omniscient Digital’s Privacy Policy explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Omniscient Digital’s use of your personal information.
